name: Takanawa-Gateway
tagline: Shinagawa in 2 minutes and Tokyo in 12 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where JR East run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 26 minutes to Shinjuku, 18 minutes to Shibuya and 2 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 3.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 22.3 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.6 m to 24.9 m, a difference of 22.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

groceries.name: 成城石井 ニュウマン高輪店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 地域医療機能推進機構東京高輪病院, about 16 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 桜十字白金リハビリテーション病院, about 23 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line. Both lines are run by JR East, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿; trains from here toward 新宿 pass through it. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000 and 2LDK ¥360,000 to ¥370,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For One room, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Sengakuji; for quiet, Takanawa-Gateway.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Takanawa-Gateway. Takanawa-Gateway adds the JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line; Sengakuji adds the Keikyu Main Line and Toei Asakusa Line. Sengakuji is 7 minutes quicker to Roppongi, but times to the other main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥11,000 less at Sengakuji. On quiet, Takanawa-Gateway comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Shinagawa; for how little of the area is in the flood projection, Takanawa-Gateway.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Takanawa-Gateway. Both have the JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line. Shinagawa also has the 4 lines, which Takanawa-Gateway does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥13,000 less at Shinagawa. On quiet, Takanawa-Gateway comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People who would rather not walk up and down slopes
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 第一京浜 (3 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. Traffic on it never stops
高輪麻布線 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: JR Yamanote Line trains toward 新宿 pass through the line's busiest stretch, but at 136% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
